1.0.0: Initial release: Qlik Cloud apps (find, get, create, update, copy, publish, delete), reloads (reload and wait for the result, get, find, cancel), reports (generate a PDF, PowerPoint or PNG of a sheet or visualization), spaces (find, get, create, update, delete), data files (upload, find, delete), users (find, get, invite), automations (find, run and wait for the result), Reload Finished, New App, App Deleted and New User webhook triggers, and Make API Call.
